geographicFilter: Representative point within PDOK province polygons; offshore outside polygons excluded. Bounding-box centre can exclude boundary-straddling plants.
scope: Solar-farm ways and wind-turbine nodes within Dutch provincial boundaries. Relation-only solar sites, offshore outside provincial polygons, and other plant technologies are excluded from this extract. Other plants remain in the separate historical registry. Mapped objects, not a complete census. Sites and individual generators can overlap; capacities must not be summed. Rooftop solar is not comprehensively included. Current operation is unverified.
